items.prompt_en: A square display has 15 rows of 15 tiles. How many tiles are there?
items.prompt_hi: Ek square display mein 15 rows hain, aur har row mein 15 tiles hain. Kul kitne tiles hain?

items.prompt_en: A school arranges 196 chairs in a square, with equal rows and columns. How many chairs are in each row?
items.prompt_hi: School 196 chairs ko square mein lagata hai, jismein rows aur columns barabar hain. Har row mein kitni chairs hain?

items.prompt_en: A cubical stack contains 343 identical boxes, with the same number along each edge. How many boxes are along one edge?
items.prompt_hi: Ek cube-shaped stack mein 343 ek jaise boxes hain. Har edge par boxes ki sankhya barabar hai. Ek edge par kitne boxes hain?

items.prompt_en: A video is shared with 3 people, and each of them shares it with 3 new people. How many new people receive it in the second round?
items.prompt_hi: Ek video 3 logon ko share hota hai. Unmein se har koi use 3 naye logon ko share karta hai. Doosre round mein kitne naye log video paate hain?

items.prompt_en: A calculation contains 2^5 × 2^3. Write its value as a number.
items.prompt_hi: Ek calculation mein 2^5 × 2^3 hai. Iski value ek number mein likho.

items.prompt_en: A measurement is written as 4 × 10^−3 metres. What is it in metres?
items.prompt_hi: Ek measurement 4 × 10^−3 metres likha hai. Yeh metres mein kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: A museum label shows the Roman numeral XL. Which number does it represent?
items.prompt_hi: Museum ke label par Roman numeral XL likha hai. Yeh kaunsi sankhya dikhata hai?

items.prompt_en: In base five, the digit 2 in 243 has what value in ordinary decimal notation?
items.prompt_hi: Base five mein likhi sankhya 243 mein digit 2 ki ordinary decimal notation mein kya value hai?

items.prompt_en: A rectangular noticeboard has a diagonal of 50 cm. Its diagonals meet at their midpoints. How far is a corner from their meeting point?
items.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular noticeboard ka diagonal 50 cm hai. Uske diagonals apne midpoints par milte hain. Ek corner se milne wale point tak kitni doori hai?

items.prompt_en: Three interior angles of a quadrilateral garden are 80°, 95° and 110°. What is its fourth interior angle?
items.prompt_hi: Ek chaar-kone wale garden ke teen andar ke angles 80°, 95° aur 110° hain. Chautha andar ka angle kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: A parallelogram-shaped tile has one interior angle of 65°. What is the interior angle next to it?
items.prompt_hi: Ek parallelogram-shaped tile ka ek andar ka angle 65° hai. Uske bagal wala andar ka angle kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: What digit can replace the blank in 4_2 so that the resulting three-digit number is divisible by 9?
items.prompt_hi: 4_2 mein blank ki jagah kaunsa digit aayega taaki bani hui teen-digit sankhya 9 se divisible ho?

items.prompt_en: Three angles of a quadrilateral-shaped school garden are 80°, 95° and 110°. What is its fourth angle?
items.prompt_hi: School garden ke quadrilateral ke teen kon 80°, 95° aur 110° hain. Chautha kon kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: The five-digit number 43?26 is divisible by 9. What digit replaces ?
items.prompt_hi: Paanch ankon ki sankhya 43?26, 9 se divisible hai. ? ki jagah kaunsa ank aayega?

items.prompt_en: A shop packs 48 boxes, each with 102 pencils. Use 102 = 100 + 2 to find the total number of pencils.
items.prompt_hi: Ek dukaan 48 boxes pack karti hai, har box mein 102 pencils hain. 102 = 100 + 2 use karke kul pencils nikalo.

items.prompt_en: A square courtyard has side 23 m. Find its area using (20 + 3)².
items.prompt_hi: Ek square courtyard ki side 23 m hai. (20 + 3)² use karke uska area nikalo.

items.prompt_en: A sports drink mixes 750 mL water with 450 mL juice. What is the water-to-juice ratio in simplest form? Give your answer as a fraction.
items.prompt_hi: Sports drink mein 750 mL paani aur 450 mL juice milaya gaya. Paani aur juice ka ratio simplest form mein fraction ke roop mein likho.

items.prompt_en: Five identical notebooks cost ₹120. At the same price per notebook, how much do eight notebooks cost?
items.prompt_hi: Paanch ek jaise notebooks ki keemat ₹120 hai. Usi rate par aath notebooks ki keemat kitni hogi?

items.prompt_en: A phone battery is 3/8 charged. What percentage is charged?
items.prompt_hi: Phone ki battery 3/8 charged hai. Yeh kitne percent charge ke barabar hai?

items.prompt_en: A jacket marked ₹800 has a 15% discount. What is its price after the discount?
items.prompt_hi: ₹800 ki jacket par 15% discount hai. Discount ke baad jacket ki keemat kitni hogi?

items.prompt_en: A square tile has side 6 cm. A larger square has twice its area. What is the larger square’s area?
items.prompt_hi: Ek square tile ki side 6 cm hai. Ek bade square ka area iska dugna hai. Bade square ka area kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: A ladder reaches 12 m up a wall, and its foot is 5 m from the wall. How long is the ladder?
items.prompt_hi: Ek ladder deewar par 12 m ki oonchai tak pahunchti hai. Uska neeche wala sira deewar se 5 m door hai. Ladder kitni lambi hai?

items.prompt_en: A school divides 500 badges among three teams in the ratio 2:3:5. How many badges does the second team receive?
items.prompt_hi: School 500 badges ko teen teams mein 2:3:5 ke ratio mein baantta hai. Doosri team ko kitne badges milenge?

items.prompt_en: Six workers can paint a school wall in 12 days. At the same rate, how many days will nine workers take?
items.prompt_hi: Chhe workers school ki deewar 12 din mein paint karte hain. Usi rate par nau workers ko kitne din lagenge?

items.prompt_en: On a map, 1 cm represents 4 km. A cycle route measures 6.5 cm on the map. How long is the actual route?
items.prompt_hi: Map par 1 cm ka matlab 4 km hai. Cycle route map par 6.5 cm hai. Asli route kitna lamba hai?

items.prompt_en: Three school teams share ₹4,800 in the ratio 2:3:5. How much does the team with the largest share receive?
items.prompt_hi: Teen school teams ₹4,800 ko 2:3:5 ke ratio mein baantti hain. Sabse bada hissa paane wali team ko kitne rupaye milenge?

items.prompt_en: In a pie chart, 90° represents students who walk to school. If 240 students were surveyed, how many walk to school?
items.prompt_hi: Pie chart mein 90° school paidal jaane wale students ko dikhata hai. Agar 240 students ka survey hua, toh kitne paidal jaate hain?

items.prompt_en: Six workers can pack a fixed order in 10 hours. At the same rate, how many hours would 15 workers take?
items.prompt_hi: Chhe workers ek fixed order 10 ghante mein pack karte hain. Usi speed se 15 workers ko kitne ghante lagenge?

items.prompt_en: A pattern starts with 1 square. At each step, every square is replaced by 4 smaller squares. How many small squares are there after 3 replacements?
items.prompt_hi: Ek pattern 1 square se shuru hota hai. Har step mein har square ki jagah 4 chhote squares aate hain. 3 replacements ke baad kitne chhote squares honge?

items.prompt_en: A box has 6 square faces. Its net has 4 squares in a straight row and one square attached above and below the second square. What solid does it form?
items.prompt_hi: Ek box ke 6 square faces hain. Uske net mein 4 squares seedhi row mein hain, aur doosre square ke upar aur neeche ek-ek square juda hai. Kaunsa solid banega?

items.prompt_en: A cricket team scored 12, 18, 15 and 11 runs in four overs. How many runs must it score in the fifth over for a mean of 15 runs per over?
items.prompt_hi: Cricket team ne chaar overs mein 12, 18, 15 aur 11 runs banaye. Paanch overs ka mean 15 runs per over karne ke liye paanchve over mein kitne runs chahiye?

items.prompt_en: A line graph shows a reservoir at 42%, 38%, 31% and 35% full on Monday through Thursday. What is the largest drop between consecutive days?
items.prompt_hi: Line graph mein reservoir Monday se Thursday tak 42%, 38%, 31% aur 35% bhara dikhaya gaya hai. Lagataar do dinon ke beech sabse badi girawat kitne percentage points hai?

items.prompt_en: Riya thinks of a number, doubles it, adds 14, then divides by 2. The result is 25. What number did she start with?
items.prompt_hi: Riya ek number sochti hai, use double karti hai, 14 jodti hai, phir 2 se divide karti hai. Result 25 hai. Shuruaati number kya tha?

items.prompt_en: In a number pyramid, each block equals the sum of the two directly below it. The bottom row is 7, 9, 5. What number is at the top?
items.prompt_hi: Number pyramid mein har block apne seedhe neeche ke do blocks ka sum hai. Neeche ki row 7, 9, 5 hai. Sabse upar ka number kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A parallelogram-shaped school banner has base 1.8 m and perpendicular height 0.75 m. It is cut along a diagonal. What is the area of one triangular half?
items.prompt_hi: School ka parallelogram-shaped banner 1.8 m base aur 0.75 m perpendicular height ka hai. Use diagonal par kaata gaya. Ek triangular half ka area kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A trapezium-shaped garden has parallel sides of 14 m and 22 m, and a perpendicular height of 8 m. A 4 m² pond occupies part of it. What planting area remains?
items.prompt_hi: Trapezium-shaped garden ki parallel sides 14 m aur 22 m hain, aur perpendicular height 8 m hai. Ismein 4 m² ka pond hai. Paudhe lagane ke liye kitna area bachta hai?
